name: Bloodscalp Clan Heads
label: Quest
description: Following the sorting of trophies gathered in the jungle, Nimboya confirms that the missing young troll Yenniku was not among them. To discover the truth…
intro: Following the sorting of trophies gathered in the jungle, Nimboya confirms that the missing young troll Yenniku was not among them. To discover the truth of Yenniku's fate, the Darkspear seek to compel answers from the leaders of the rival Bloodscalp tribe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yenniku was not among the heads, and I thank the Great Serpent for it. But we are no closer to finding him.

We must know the truth, and I fear that only the Bloodscalp chief and his witchdoctor know it. They are the enemies of the Darkspear tribe and will not speak freely, so we must force the truth from their dead lips!
Bring me the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok the Dire and place them within this cauldron.
They are deep within Zul'Kunda. Bring their heads...we will then make them talk.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The greenish broth within the cauldron bubbles.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok within the cauldron...
